Date March 25, 1942

SUBJECT:
AXIS ATTITUDE TOWARDS FAR EASTERN SITUATION.

Certain discontent is existing among German and
Italian business men in Shanghai in connection with
restrictions imposed upon them by the Nipponese
Military Authorities.

It was originally believed by these circles that
Japan's Axis partners will enjoy right and privileges
in Shanghai, but now they regard themselves as being
treated almost in the same way as enemy nationals.

Thought is gradually gaining ground among prominent
Germans and Italians in Shanghai that the Far East will
eventually be closed economically and otherwise to all
Europeens, including Germans and Italians, and that all
trade possibilities will disappear.

The ever-increasing military and economical might of
Japan is evidently begining to worry her Axis partners
who consider that there may be no limit to Japan's
expansion.

There is a belief among local leading Nazis that a
Buffer State would be formed in the Asiatic part of
Russia following the defeat of the Red Army and that
this Buffer State will separate Russian territories
to be occupied by Germans, from Japan.

To prove this theory the local Germans cite a certain
passage in German Fuehrer's speech on the occasion of
celebrations of Heroes' Memorial Day on March 15th 1942

（批：Mr. Saito's Translation is attached）

主题：
轴心国对远东局势的态度。

上海的德国和意大利商人因日本军事当局对他们施加的限制而存在某种不满情绪。

这些圈子最初认为，日本的轴心国伙伴将在上海享有权利和特权，但现在他们认为自己受到的待遇几乎与敌国国民相同。

在上海的知名德国人和意大利人中，一种观点逐渐占据上风，即远东最终将在经济和其他方面对所有欧洲人（包括德国人和意大利人）关闭，所有贸易可能性都将消失。

日本日益增长的军事和经济实力显然开始令其轴心国伙伴感到担忧，他们认为日本的扩张可能没有限度。

当地纳粹头目中存在一种信念，即在红军战败后，将在俄罗斯的亚洲部分建立一个缓冲国，该缓冲国将把德国人将要占领的俄罗斯领土与日本隔开。

为了证明这一理论，当地德国人引用了德国元首在1942年3月15日英雄纪念日庆祝活动上的讲话中的某一段落

（批：附斋藤先生译文）
（印：归档）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No.N.361(C).
Special Branch, S.I.............Station,
REPORT                          Date...Sept...10th...1940.
Subject (in full)...REPORTED REACTION OF LOCAL GERMAN AND ITALIAN COMMERCIAL
CIRCLES TO GROWING JAPANESE INFLUENCE.
Made by.......................................Forwarded by.......................................

From a source close to Comdr. L. Neyrone, Italian
Consul-General, it was learned that the Italian and
German Authorities here, do not intend to let the
Japanese have the upper hand in Shanghai Municipal
and other affairs.
A firm belief is reported to exist amongst Italian
and German Commercial Circles here that the Japanese
influence should be suppressed.
Local German and Italian Commercial Circles have
lately been worried over the increasing Japanese
intentions to monopolise the local trade and are reported
to have made representations to their respective
Authorities asking for protection of their trade
interests.

主题（全称）...据报当地德国和意大利商界对日本影响力日益增强的反应。
制作人.......................................转发人.......................................

从接近意大利总领事 L. Neyrone 指挥官的消息来源获悉，此地的意大利和德国当局不打算让日本人在上海公共租界及其他事务中占据上风。
据报道，此地的意大利和德国商界坚信应当抑制日本的影响力。
当地德国和意大利商界最近对日本人垄断当地贸易的意图日益增强感到担忧，并据报已向各自当局提出交涉，要求保护其贸易利益。
